description: Open and forecast public funding calls in one schema: US Grants.gov (every federal agency), EU Funding & Tenders (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, LIFE, EU4Health, Erasmus+, cascade calls) and UKRI. Title, funder, programme, grant size (min/max), total budget, expected awards, deadline, eligibility, contacts, link. Soonest deadline first. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/grants-radar on your Apify account (about $0.003 per call; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_forecasts.description: Include calls announced but not open yet.

keywords.description: Words matched on title, programme and description, e.g. ["battery", "energy storage"].

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

min_award.description: Smallest grant size wanted (maximum award, in the call currency).

min_days_to_deadline.description: Leave out calls closing sooner than this.

name: search_grants

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search open public funding calls
